limits: SEEN-096's re-ask at 0.79 is one reading of one record on 24 September against jev-1.13.0. It says the fix moved the score a long way; it does not say the record is now good enough, and it is not, being a hundredth short.

must_fix came back yes at 0.50 against its 0.7 threshold on this ticket's review, a coin flip rather than a judgement. The review found three real defects, one of them high, all resolved before the advance, so the gate cleared on the numbers; a reader should not take 0.50 as agreement.
ticket_source is now in every gate payload, so every question sees one extra short string. The effect on other questions' scores is unmeasured.
The review was a self-review, like every ticket in this epic. An independent pass over the harness is still owed.
Only state_for was fixed. Nothing else in the harness that reads a ticket path was audited for the same assumption.
